name: vendora
description: Vendora - Multi-tenant POS and E-commerce Platform

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "green,blue" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && composer install && cd ../client-side && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run setup:env && npm run migrate
scripts.setup:env: cd server && (if not exist .env copy .env.example .env) && php artisan key:generate
